item.title: Park City Mountain to celebrate, support ladies with return of Women’s Weekend
item.description: The weekend events, from March 6-8 coinciding with International Women’s Day on March 8, will include women-led, women-only clinics for beginner, intermediate and advanced skiers and boarders, as well as celebratory brunches, DJ sets, a party lap and even a sound bowl session. item.title: Liberty Sanctuary combines rescue and advocacy to protect America’s equine
item.description: The sanctuary today is home to 26 horses, including seven mustangs from the Bureau of Land Management, seven reservation horses and 12 domestic horses, along with three sheep and four donkeys — two burros from the BLM and two mini donkeys. item.title: Brent Folan, the Pin King of Milano Cortina, builds connection one trade at a time
item.description: Brent Folan is a three-time Olympic attendee and global traveler, recognizable in his American flag onesie as he trades pins with athletes, volunteers and fans. After first attending the Rio Games in 2016, he has since visited more than 100 countries and now returns each Olympic cycle to build connections through the Games’ unofficial currency: pins. item.title: Wasatch County School District receives over $500,000 in grant funding to support career tech
item.description: The lion’s share of funding comes from a Catalyst Center grant administered by the Utah State Board of Education. The Catalyst Center Grant Program was established after the approval of H.B. 447 in May 2025 and awards funding “to support innovative programs that strengthen career pathways and expand opportunities for students across the state,” according to a Utah State Board of Education press release.
